description.p: Markdownz is a fast, lightweight viewer for Markdown and PDF documents. Open a file, read it, press Escape and it is gone.

ul.li: GitHub-flavored Markdown: tables, task lists, alerts, footnotes and emoji
Mermaid and Graphviz diagrams, KaTeX math and syntax highlighting
PDF documents with text selection, links, outline and find
Tabs that are restored on the next start
Tree-shaped history: going back and following another link keeps both branches
Live reload when the file changes, find in page, zoom and a table of contents
Printing with preview: pages per sheet, booklets and two-sided printing
Light and dark theme following the system

description.p: Every extension can be switched off in the settings. Scripts in documents are removed and nothing is downloaded while viewing.

screenshot.caption: Mermaid and Graphviz diagrams with a table of contents
Tables, alerts and code in the dark theme

description.p: Printing: text size setting, a choice between continuing too wide tables below or cutting them off, code lines that wrap instead of being cut, and diagrams and pictures that get landscape pages and are never cut or split. Zoom now belongs to each document, with a button to reset it to 100 %.
Made for wide screens: documents side by side, a page view showing the document as printed, and wide tables, diagrams and images using the room next to the text, with a width ruler.

Printing: pages with wide tables turn landscape while the text continues on the left, wide content shrinks down to a minimum text size and splits by columns, table headers repeat, and single pages can be turned by markers in the file or your own exceptions.
Windows: opening documents no longer triggers a Windows Installer repair for other users of a per-machine installation. The Flatpak build is back.
Checks for a new version once a day and offers to install it. The installer publisher is now drzdez.
Recent documents on the start page and in the open menu, with a folder button and detection of deleted files. Print margins can also apply at the fold.
New print dialog with preview: 1, 2 or 4 pages per sheet, booklets and two-sided printing, also manually on printers without duplex.
PDF documents open in the same tabs and history. Documents can be handed to other applications with “Open with…”.
